items.title: Pavilion in the Oaks / Mork-Ulnes Architects
items.summary: The clients approached Mork-Ulnes Architects with a desire for a flexible space that could provide a meditative, spa-like experience for exercise, yoga, and quiet contemplation, as well as a place for social gatherings with their extended family and friends.

items.title: Nvidia Employees Push Board to Bring Back Jensen Huang: Report
items.summary: An internal post urging Nvidia's board to weigh staff sentiment has drawn more than 1,600 comments, including calls to reinstate Huang.

items.title: Congress Summons Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, Lutnick Over Chip Exports to China
items.summary: House panels requested December interviews with Huang and Nvidia's top lawyer as scrutiny shifts to Commerce's oversight of chip exports.
